```python
import pytest

from your_module import levenshtein


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s1", "s2", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param("abc", "abc", 0, id="identical-strings"),
        pytest.param("abc", "abd", 1, id="single-substitution"),
        pytest.param("abc", "ab", 1, id="single-deletion"),
        pytest.param("ab", "abc", 1, id="single-insertion-left-shorter"),
        pytest.param("kitten", "sitting", 3, id="classic-kitten-sitting"),
        pytest.param("flaw", "lawn", 2, id="classic-flaw-lawn"),
        pytest.param("gumbo", "gambol", 2, id="mixed-insert-substitute"),
        pytest.param("Saturday", "Sunday", 3, id="multiple-edits"),
        pytest.param("ABC", "abc", 3, id="case-sensitive"),
        pytest.param("a b c", "abc", 2, id="whitespace-counts"),
        pytest.param("café", "cafe", 1, id="unicode-accent"),
        pytest.param("😀😃😄", "😀😄", 1, id="unicode-emoji"),
        pytest.param("aaaa", "aa", 2, id="repeated-characters"),
    ],
)
def test_levenshtein_known_distances(s1: str, s2: str, expected: int) -> None:
    assert levenshtein(s1, s2) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "value",
    [
        pytest.param("", id="empty"),
        pytest.param("a", id="single-char"),
        pytest.param("abc", id="ascii"),
        pytest.param("😀😃", id="emoji"),
        pytest.param("a b\nc", id="whitespace-and-newline"),
    ],
)
def test_levenshtein_distance_to_empty_string_is_length(value: str) -> None:
    assert levenshtein(value, "") == len(value)
    assert levenshtein("", value) == len(value)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s1", "s2"),
    [
        pytest.param("kitten", "sitting", id="classic"),
        pytest.param("", "abc", id="empty-left"),
        pytest.param("abc", "", id="empty-right"),
        pytest.param("short", "a much longer string", id="different-lengths"),
        pytest.param("café", "cafe", id="unicode"),
        pytest.param("same", "same", id="identical"),
    ],
)
def test_levenshtein_is_symmetric(s1: str, s2: str) -> None:
    assert levenshtein(s1, s2) == levenshtein(s2, s1)


def test_levenshtein_handles_long_strings() -> None:
    s1 = "a" * 100 + "b" * 50
    s2 = "a" * 100 + "c" * 50

    assert levenshtein(s1, s2) == 50


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s1", "s2"),
    [
        pytest.param(None, "abc", id="none-left"),
        pytest.param("abc", None, id="none-right"),
        pytest.param(123, "abc", id="int-left"),
        pytest.param("abc", 123, id="int-right"),
        pytest.param(object(), "abc", id="object-left"),
        pytest.param("abc", object(), id="object-right"),
    ],
)
def test_levenshtein_invalid_inputs_raise_type_error(s1: object, s2: object) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        levenshtein(s1, s2)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
```
